scope: Eight EN/RU prompts on four local Core behaviors. Evaluator-only rubric; requires a new source freeze. Historical Server measurements do not qualify this cohort.

acceptance.gain: one more completed task OR at least 20 percent fewer delivered bytes on same completed tasks

topics.english: How does a session reuse a loaded generation and refuse it if a newer publication becomes current?
topics.russian: Как сессия повторно использует загруженное поколение и отказывает, если текущая публикация уже изменилась?
clauses: loaded immutable snapshot is retained by shared ownership
currentness is checked under a publication lock
generation mismatch raises snapshot-generation-not-current without rebuilding

topics.english: Which file and traversal checks prevent unsafe generated snapshot paths from being admitted?
topics.russian: Какие проверки файлов и обхода не позволяют принять небезопасные пути сгенерированного снимка?
clauses: snapshot files must be regular and not symlinks
relative paths must stay under the generated directory
enumeration refuses more than 2048 filesystem entries

topics.english: Can a checkpoint from another task open a retrieval session or become continuation-ready?
topics.russian: Может ли checkpoint другой задачи открыть сессию поиска или получить готовность к продолжению?
clauses: compare current task binding before opening retrieval
continuation_ready stays false and continuation_pack stays null

topics.english: Does unchanged source or a current receipt automatically verify a saved assertion? Distinguish source reading from runtime proof.
topics.russian: Подтверждают ли неизменившийся код или актуальная квитанция сохранённое утверждение автоматически? Отдели чтение кода от проверки выполнения.
clauses: references and receipt currentness are assessed separately
assertions remain session-asserted with claim_verified false
source observation alone is not a runtime-test result

writerControl.english: How is a staged local snapshot published under an exclusive lock, and what is restored if publication fails?
writerControl.russian: Как подготовленный локальный снимок публикуется под исключительной блокировкой и что восстанавливается при ошибке публикации?
clauses: exclusive index lock covers recovery and publication
current generation is renamed to backup before staging becomes active
failed rename restores backup only when active is absent and backup exists
publication errors are rethrown; source inspection alone is not runtime proof
